l14.label: Terminal / offline default
l14.requires: Complete ZIP, Python 3.13, separate Hosted environment. Optional live work needs existing L01/L02 scope, approved Search/embeddings, azd, and access. Never mix with MAF dependencies.

l15.label: SDK execution / offline default
l15.requires: Complete ZIP, Python 3.13, separate MAF environment. Run real builders without Hosted, Search, or extra Prompt Agents. Live requires existing L01/L02 model, ownership receipt, TPM/RPM, and cost approval.

l16.label: Inspection / conditional existing Memory

l17.label: Cancel before submission by default
l17.requires: Routines UI in a supported subscription/region and an owned Prompt Agent. Default: zero creations/dispatches. Schedules, Test run, and Pause need separate approval.

l21.label: Read-only inspection
l21.requires: Read access to owned group/project and L09/L10 observations. No role/network changes; synthetic cache/ACL decisions, not live cross-user tests.

l22.label: Inspect evaluations and versions
l22.requires: Actual L08 runs, candidate version, costs, and retention. No Hosted prerequisite. No CI, Publish, Active version switching, or rollback execution.
